Wisdom.text: When you Offer or Exalt, look at the top 2 cards of the Host deck. Put 1 into your hand and discard the other.

Gabriel.text: In the Morning: Look at another player's hand, then name Light or Dark. If they Offer a card of that alignment this Day, gain 1 Glory.
Gabriel.why: The seer: reading a hand becomes income (V43)

Tree of Life.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leaned with the Tide today and yesterday, gain 1 Glory.
Tree of Life.cadence: At the end of the Day

Hymn.text: When you Offer this card, it goes face up.
Hymn.why: A +2 anchor and a loud public vote (V43)

Lamentation.text: When you Offer this card, it goes face up.

Martyr.text: When another card is discarded from your Choir, gain 1 Glory.
Martyr.cadence: When a card leaves your Choir

Tribute.text: Other players must pay you 1 Glory before they may Target any card in your Choir.
Tribute.why: The fee goes to you, not the Pot (V43)

Remnant.text: At the end of the Day: If 2 or more places in your Choir are empty, gain 1 Glory.
Remnant.cadence: At the end of the Day
Remnant.why: The ascetic: pays while your Choir is small (V43)

Lilith.text: When a card is discarded from another player's Choir, you may put it into your hand.
Lilith.cadence: When a card leaves a Choir

Parasite.text: When you Exalt or Gather this card, put it into another player's Choir instead. They cannot discard it. At the end of each Day, if they lost Glory, you gain 1 Glory; if they gained Glory, discard this card.

Snare.text: When another player Gathers, flips, or discards a card you placed on the Altar, gain 1 Glory.
Snare.why: A trap for the hidden Altar (V43)

Eternity.text: At the end of the Day: You may keep one card on the Altar, face up, through the next Day.
Eternity.cadence: At the end of the Day

Twilight.text: At the end of the Day: If the other cards in your Choir hold as many Light cards as Dark cards (at least 1 each), gain 2 Glory.
Twilight.cadence: At the end of the Day

Council.text: In the Morning: You may name another player. At the end of the Day, if your Choirs lean the same way, each of you gains 1 Glory.
Council.why: The broker: rewards forming a partnership (V43)

Forger.text: When you Gather or Exalt, you may take the card from the discard pile instead.

Mirage.text: Other players cannot Gather, flip, look at, exchange, or destroy cards you placed on the Altar before the Evening.

Apple.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans the other way from yesterday, gain 2 Glory.
Apple.cadence: At the end of the Day
Apple.why: Switching sides is costly, so it pays more (V43)

Fig Leaves.text: In the Evening, before the Altar is revealed: You may have your Choir sit out this Day. It gains nothing, loses nothing, and does not count as leaning either way.
Fig Leaves.why: Decided after every turn, before the reveal (V43)

Raphael.text: When you Offer a Light card, you may turn it face up to destroy a face-up Dark card on the Altar.

Azazel.text: When you Offer a Dark card, you may turn it face up to destroy a face-up Light card on the Altar.

Flaming Sword.text: On your turn: No other player may Exalt or Gather until the start of your next turn.
Flaming Sword.why: Shuts down building for a round (V43)

Leviathan.text: At the end of the Day: If the Tide won by 3 or more and your Choir leans with it, gain 1 Glory.
Leviathan.cadence: At the end of the Day

Defiance.text: At the end of the Day: If your Choir leans with the Tide and more Choirs leaned against it than with it, gain 1 Glory.
Defiance.cadence: At the end of the Day

Favor.text: At the end of the Day: If 2 or more other players lost Glory this Day, gain 1 Glory.
Favor.cadence: At the end of the Day
Favor.why: Leviathan's old ability: spared while others fall (V43)
